title: Resolution urging Albany to limit shackling of pregnant inmates
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.2667C/A.1670A, which would bar restraints on incarcerated people during labor, delivery and postpartum recovery except in narrowly defined extraordinary circumstances. The bill would also extend protections to pregnant and post-pregnancy individuals in law enforcement custody and during interrogations, restrict use of force against them, allow a support person during medical care and require reporting whenever exceptions are invoked.
